summary: The 'Loggedout' file is a server-side script that defines a screen named 'LoggedOut' and handles user sessions with session state disabled. It includes shared logic for screen rendering.
purpose: To display the 'LoggedOut' screen when a user has logged out or is no longer authenticated, without enabling session state.

fields.name: strScreenName
fields.description: Set to 'LoggedOut' to identify the purpose of this screen.

actors.description: A user who has logged out and is presented with the 'LoggedOut' screen.

workflows.name: Show LoggedOut Screen
steps: User accesses the application after logging out or session ends.
The script disables session state and sets response buffering and expiration.
Shared screen logic is included and executed.

business_rules: Session state must be disabled for this screen.
Response should not be cached (expires immediately).
validations: Session is not active for this screen.
conditions: User must be logged out or session must have ended.
system_behavior: Response is buffered and set to expire immediately to prevent caching.
Shared screen logic is included via 'DoScreen.asp'.

dependencies.description: Shared ASP logic for rendering the screen.

exceptions: If user is not logged out, screen may not be shown.
content_gaps: No field or entity definitions beyond screen name.
No details about post-logout options or navigation.
